messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: multiple p99 latency spikes observed for embeddings-serving in us-west and eu-west. Threshold breached: p99 > 2.5s for 7m. Paging eng-oncall. Link: https://ops.example.com/incidents/INC-76051 :rotating_light:

Alex G.: saw the bot, pulling live graphs now. first glance: CPU on the primary pool is saturated, KV cache eviction rate up, fallback routing kicking in for some tenants.

Priya S.: taking primary for the next hour. what’s current customer impact? any active pager escalations to customers?

Jamie L.: no external customer pages yet, but internal SLOs for embeddings inference are being violated (p99 > 2.5s). A few clients are seeing timeouts at 10s and retries. Observed error spike in model-worker pods: OOMKilled x3 in last 6m.

Maria T.: I can cover secondary region routing (eu-west) for next 45m. planning to start a partial drain + scale up.

Alex G.: mitigation plan in progress: 1) scale dedicated-pool-uswest to +50% GPUs, 2) enable kv-cache read-only mode to reduce eviction churn, 3) temporarily increase request-timeout for embeddings route to 15s (avoid client retries), 4) failover lower-priority tenants to cheaper quantized variant. executing now.

Jamie L.: running scaling command (k8s autoscaler is stuck on cooldown):
```sh
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/dedicated-pool-uswest --replicas=6
```
Started at 7605123478.

Priya S.: linking runbook steps for containment: sre-runbook-bot:runbook:embeddings-p99 (https://confluence.example.com/sre/runbooks/embeddings-p99). follow sections 2/3 (scale + cache) then escalate to infra if GPU allocation fails.

sre-runbook-bot: Automated suggestion: consider enabling routing-policy:regional-failover and kv-cache-readonly toggle. CLI snippets in runbook section.

Alex G.: logs snippet from model-worker-7 before OOM: ```
2026-11-12T01:02:45Z ERROR transformer: context-window allocation failed: tried to allocate 3.6GB
2026-11-12T01:02:45Z WARN  kvcache: eviction-rate=0.87
```
Looks like larger requests temporarily pushed memory high.

Maria T.: scale command applied to eu-west pool as well. also enabled temporary rate-limit for developer-tier to 20rps via feature-gate (lowers burst).

Priya S.: quick checklist for incoming oncall: - primary: Priya S. (us-west containment) - secondary: Maria T. (eu-west failover) - observers: Alex G., Jamie L. - runbook link posted above - customer-impact: degraded p99, some timeouts, not full outage

Alex G.: alert routing note: silenced paging to infra-team (they are on-call for provisioning but we control scaling). retained pager to eng-oncall and product-SL.

Jamie L.: monitoring: watching three dashboards: embeddings-p99, model-worker-memory, kvcache-evictions. alert thresholds adjusted (p99 alarm now set to 3.5s for suppression for 10m while we stabilize).

oncall-bot: NOTE: please update the incident channel when you flip any routing or change SLAs. Use `!incident update` to append.

Priya S.: taking the bridge. I’ll keep periodic updates every 10m or on any state change. next check 7605123950.

Alex G.: summary for handoff bundle to the next shift: - current state: scaling in progress, eu-west scaled, us-west scaling finishing (pods coming up) - mitigations active: kv-cache read-only, rate-limit developer-tier, increased timeouts, temporary failover to quantized model for low-priority tenants - customer impact: elevated p99 and intermittent timeouts for small subset of customers; no SEV yet - open actions: confirm pod stability (no more OOMKILLs), monitor eviction rate <0.2, verify that autoscaler cooldown is fixed (file infra ticket if not) - who to ping next: @maria for region swap, @jamie for logs + memory traces, @alex for perf graphs

Maria T.: noted. I’ll validate request logs and run a synthetic embedding call across the failover path. posting results to thread.

Jamie L.: FYI I enabled additional log retention for model workers (+1h) in case we need postmortem traces.

Priya S.: handed off at 7605124520 to night-shift oncall. If anything degrades, escalate to incident channel and tag me. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder: update PD incident (PD-76051) and set incident severity if customer pages escalate.

Alex G.: leaving notes in the incident doc now — linking to this thread. good job team, keep updates concise and timed.

(End of thread)
